title: Petra and the Cipher
author: A. M. Quintana
blurb: Bram Vane, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
